newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Bank to close Australian office, unit.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Bank to close Australian office, unit.

text.p: Daiwa Bank Ltd said on Thursday that it would close down its representative office and a subsidiary in Australia before the end of this year as part of its efforts to restructure its overseas operations.
The bank said its Sydney representative office will be closed on July 31, while wholly owned Daiwa Finance Australia Ltd will be shut on December 15.
The bank currently has 28 offices and subsidiaries overseas.

Daiwa has been restructuring its overseas operations since it was fined for concealing a $1.1 billion loss by a bond trader at its New York branch in the summer of 1995. In November 1995, U.S. regulatory authorities ordered Daiwa to close its U.S. operations.
